properties.label: Western Ghats
properties.definition: Union of the four North/South Western Ghats moist deciduous and montane rain-forest ecoregions in RESOLVE 2017. An operational ecological definition, not an administrative boundary.

properties.label: Deccan Plateau dryland subregion
properties.definition: Deccan thorn scrub forests north of 12 N. This predeclared dryland subregion avoids Sri Lankan portions and the southern peninsula and represents the plan's dryland contrast; it is not the entire plateau or proof of present-day savanna land cover.

properties.label: Eastern Himalayan foothill subregion
properties.definition: Himalayan subtropical broadleaf forests east of 88 E, a reproducible Bhutan/eastern foothill segment of the published Siwalik foothill ecoregion. The cutoff is a study decision, not an official eastern-Himalaya boundary; this is not the whole Himalayan range.
